# VerticalAlignment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Defines vertical alignment within an available layout region.

The counterpart to [`HorizontalAlignment`](horizontal-alignment.md). Meaningful on a container that has more vertical room than its child needs - typically one given an explicit `height` - which is what makes it possible to anchor content to the bottom of a fixed box without hand-computing a top padding.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new VerticalAlignment()
```

## Properties

- [`Center`](#center): Align to the middle
- [`End`](#end): Align to the bottom
- [`Start`](#start): Align to the top
- [`Stretch`](#stretch): Stretch to fill available space
